text: Mima Kirigoe leaves the J-pop idol group CHAM! to become an actress, and an obsessive fan, Me-Mania, begins to stalk her. A website called Mima's Room records her private thoughts in her own voice, while her new television role [demands a rape scene she accepts against her manager's objections|trigger|saying yes to an offer]. As [the people who work on her career are murdered|who_suffers|people at work], Mima [can no longer tell her life from her acting|origin|a mind turning on itself], haunted by [an apparition of her idol self|threat|impostors and doubles] who claims to be the real Mima.
